blocks.name: bit-membership
blocks.note: Numeric-uint32 and signed-bit-pattern forms are both explicit; bit-pattern forms avoid unnecessary unsigned scalar coercion.

blocks.name: fixed-width-word-composition
blocks.note: Generic and caller-range-proven cross-word shift profiles coexist; known count ranges avoid runtime dispatch.

blocks.name: popcount
blocks.note: One-lane, fixed two-lane, and sparse-high two-lane popcount profiles are separately costed; initialization/workload evidence selects the appropriate form.

blocks.name: coordinate-decode
blocks.note: Board geometry is configured at initialization; hot row/column decoding uses prepared lookup tables instead of division/modulo.

blocks.name: legal-landing-cell
blocks.note: Initialization prepares per-column next landing cells; hot landing lookup is one load and transitions update by configured column stride.

blocks.name: winning-line-test
blocks.note: Signed bit-pattern containment is preferred when masks never require unsigned numeric interpretation.

blocks.name: apply-undo-state-transition
blocks.note: Initialization selects one-lane transitions for <=32 cells or two-lane transitions for 33..64 cells; geometry remains runtime-configured and invariant thereafter.

blocks.name: hash-mix32
blocks.note: Three explicitly costed hash-mix strengths let the application trade bucket avalanche against cycles.

blocks.name: transposition-cache-probe
blocks.note: Caller computes and retains the table index once; probe is a boolean tag hit and replacement reuses the same index.

blocks.name: canonical-reflection-symmetry
blocks.note: Initialization selects no work for one column or an exact register-only 3-bit field-swap profile for 2..10 columns. These profiles beat the current direct/byte-table static L1 ledgers and require no reflection-table setup; lookup/direct forms remain qualified alternatives for emitted-code/cache studies.

blocks.name: frontier-antichain-normalization
blocks.note: Unsigned and signed-bit-pattern ordered antichain profiles are independently costed; signed lanes avoid complement normalization.

blocks.name: residual-transition
blocks.note: Class-major transition base is computed once per class and reused across actions.

blocks.name: shared-queue-enqueue-dequeue
blocks.note: Sequence atomics publish ordinary payload accesses. Blocking and nonblocking CAS-reservation profiles are separately costed; callers choose according to progress semantics.
